title: Is subsequence
summary: Return true if the characters of `part` appear in `whole` in the same order, not necessarily next to each other.
hints: Check `abc` against `ahbgdc` by hand. After you find the `a`, where do you start looking for the `b`?
Scan `whole` once from left to right while keeping track of which character of `part` you are waiting for.
Keep an index into `part`. For each character of `whole`, if it equals the character you are waiting for, advance the index. The answer is whether the index reached the end of `part`.
pattern: Two pointers moving at different speeds
takeaway: One pass, O(n). Taking the earliest possible match each time (a greedy choice) is always safe here, because matching earlier never leaves you with fewer options later.
